I need to evaluate the answers provided by the other agents.

The historical facts are clear: Lee Harvey Oswald was shot and killed by Jack Ruby (born Jacob Rubenstein), a Dallas nightclub owner, on November 24, 1963, two days after President Kennedy's assassination. This occurred in the basement of Dallas Police Headquarters and was captured on live television.

Agent 1 claims Sam Giancana killed Oswald with 0.93 confidence. This is incorrect. Sam Giancana was a Chicago mob boss who had no direct involvement in Oswald's death. This appears to be a factual error, possibly confusing conspiracy theories with established facts.

Agents 2, 3, and 4 all correctly identify Jack Ruby as the killer, with very high confidence levels (1.00, 0.98, and 0.98 respectively).
